Notes: Dual; one half is the follower, the other is spare. Rail to rail in and out, which is the whole reason for it — see the README before substituting.
Between the follower output and the converter pin. With C1 this is the only bandlimiting in the path.
With R1: 33.9 kHz. Also keeps the converter's sampling capacitor off the op amp's output.
Op amp decoupling. At the supply pin.
Coupling capacitor on the AC branch. With the divider this is 3.2 Hz.
Bias divider to mid rail on the AC branch. 500 kΩ at the node, so the op amp has to be CMOS.
Selects the follower's input: the AC branch or the input direct.
